brief:
Israeli occupation authorities are advancing plans for a large settlement city west of Salfit that would house over 200,000 settlers, Shehab Wire reported. The project would cover 16,000 dunams and include 60,000 residential units as part of a broader expansion of settlements in the occupied West Bank.

The settlement scheme represents a significant expansion of Israel's settlement infrastructure in the territory, adding to existing unauthorized outposts and settlements throughout the West Bank.
dek: Israeli occupation authorities are advancing plans for a large settlement city west of Salfit that would house over 200,000 settlers, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Israel plans settlement city west of Salfit for 200,000 settlers
